recipe.name: WorkflowSwift served-SPA shells (static, no bundler)
evidence: hand-written preact/htm shell served straight from /opt/swift/nginx/www-app/workflowswift — no bundler
declared because detection picks the Rust recipe for this repo (Cargo.toml) and `cargo run` would start a second API against the live port/DB
the recipe stays honest for Rust changes: the script runs the fmt/check/clippy compiler gate when a .rs file is among the changes (kanban t_ef3b13f4)
